330:t_016:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well then, the rest is free time for the great $$ゲイツ$$!」

330:t_017:1.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Doing this kind of work, you really feel like we've become part of $$ファイヤバグ$$.」

330:t_017:4.en:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Is it because we're just $$アマルガム$$'s subcontractor, and on top of that $$アマルガム$$ is teaming up with those guys?」

330:t_017:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「This isn't what I'm after. I want something more, you know, thrill-packed...」

330:t_018:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「$n retrieved him! We've given him first aid, but he's badly wounded!」

330:t_018:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「But the man himself is raring to go. He means to sortie.」

330:t_018:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Permission granted. Hand over that unit.」

330:t_019:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Why is the $$アーバレスト$$...」

330:t_019:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「But that thing has no $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ and no $$アル$$ aboard. It's an empty shell.」

330:t_019:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You could call it an $$アーバレスト$$ (weak version).」

330:t_019:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Even so, your habits and preferences are built into it. The rest, you'll have to manage on your own power.」

330:t_019:4.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アル$$... You're not here anymore, are you...)

330:t_019:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What do you mean, no problem... with that injury...」

330:t_019:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have to take out the trash in this town.」

330:t_019:9.en:
$n
「Let's do this for the first time in a while...!」

330:t_020:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Niiice! The cast is all coming together!」

330:t_020:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ベック$$ is here as well.」

330:t_020:3.en:
$$ベック$$
「You bet! I've been waiting for you, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!」

330:t_020:4.en:
$$ベック$$
「Burning a defenseless town is no fun at all! Pulverizing an irritating jerk like you, that's the real thrill!」

330:t_020:5.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「Don't you mean you'll be the one getting pulverized?」

330:t_020:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You're quite right, $$ドロシー#bigo$$.」

330:t_020:7.en:
$$ベック$$
「Shut up! But after today, I'm done listening to that smart mouth!」

330:t_020:8.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well then, now that things are heating up, here comes our special guest!」

330:t_021:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「It's the good people of the $$新地球皇国$$!」

330:t_021:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アマルガム$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$ working together... So they no longer intend to hide it.」

330:t_021:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「It's true those guys were already moving that way back in the $$時獄戦役$$, but...!」

330:t_021:3.en:
$$五飛$$
「Like $$ネオ・ジオン$$, those guys sold out the Earth too!」

330:t_021:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then we'll hit them all together.」

330:t_021:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn right! Time to avenge $$メリダ島$$!」

330:t_021:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「So $$レモン$$ was more than just a journalist after all...」

330:t_021:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「We don't have much time...! Let's finish this quickly!」

330:t_021:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We take down $$ファイヤバグ$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$!」

330:t_021:11.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ナミ$$... When this fight is over, I'll tell you...)

330:t_022:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「$$アマルガム$$ and the $$新地球皇国$$... Their joint front has finally come out into the open.」

330:t_022:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「They saw how weakened we are, and probably stopped bothering to hide it.」

330:t_022:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(But I don't understand... Leaving aside $$ネオ・ジオン$$, which wants itself recognized as the heir to Earth's humanity, what's in it for $$アマルガム$$...)

330:t_022:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(With the full scope of the organization called $$アマルガム$$ still unknown, the key may be $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...)

330:t_022:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This is bad! He's about to lose consciousness!」

330:t_023:1.en:
$$宗介$$
(I want to see you... I can't help it... Stay by my side, clap me on the back and say something...)

330:t_023:2.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I want to see you...)

330:t_024:0.en:
$$クラマ$$
「A pathetic stall for time, $$相良$$.」

330:t_024:2.en:
$$クラマ$$
「I've lost even my interest in killing you with my own hands. This woman has outlived her usefulness.」

330:t_026:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hmm, this won't do... The Asian humidity has made the tips of my sideburns curl.」

330:t_027:1.en:
$$ノイン$$
「I don't know either... But I don't want to get involved any further.」

330:t_028:0.en:
$$ベック$$
「That's just a greeting for today. Look forward to our next meeting, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

330:t_028:1.en:
$$ベック$$
「Next time, my astonishing plan will blow your mind!」

330:t_029:0.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「He seems to be enjoying himself.」

330:t_029:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's a real nuisance for those of us being hounded.」

330:t_100:0.en:
$$宗介$$
(Hold on, $$ナミ$$...! I will surely save you with this crossbow!)

330:t_100:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「I refuse to go through that again! Let's go, $$アル$$ II!」

330:t_101:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Nice one, $$カシム$$! Taking down that $$クラマ$$!」

330:t_101:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「My bad, my bad! $$ガウルン$$ used to call you that, so it seems to have rubbed off on your old uncle too!」
